author_direction: Retain the 20–30 billion Solar System working scale; evaluate capacity before choosing distribution; include lunar surface and aerial habitation explicitly.
reading_rule: Lunar population is lunar_surface + lunar_aerial. Orbital residents include the array and other orbital settlements; their engineering inventories must name the habitat assumption. Elsewhere is an explicit unmodelled remainder, never credited with demonstrated capacity. Scenarios are simultaneous accounting tests, not population forecasts or recommendations.

historical_scenarios.provisioning: provisioning/population.py A/B/C remain reproducible historical illustrations; they do not establish location capacities.
historical_scenarios.resources: resources/industry.py historical scenarios remain reproducible independent illustrations; use the cases in this file for new joint accounting.

habitation_direction.floating_default: Allow much floating habitation to roam; manage collision and storm risks.
habitation_direction.accounting_rule: Evaluate navigation, collision avoidance, storm routing, rendezvous, reserves and occasional repositioning. Continuous fixed-location stationkeeping is a comparison case, not a universal settlement load.
